title: SQL Injection Error Disclosure on Login
payload_used: ' (single quote in email field with password 123)
impact: Application returns an unhandled raw error object when a malformed SQL string is submitted via the email field, confirming the input is passed directly into a SQL query without sanitization and revealing a SQL injection point
remediation: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements instead of string concatenation; implement generic error messages for authentication failures instead of exposing raw backend errors

title: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass - Admin Login
payload_used: Email: ' OR 1=1-- Password: 123 (confirmed via curl against /rest/user/login)
impact: Submitting a boolean-always-true SQL injection payload in the email field bypassed authentication entirely; the response returned a valid JWT authentication token for the admin account (admin@juice-sh.op) without knowing the real password. The decoded JWT additionally exposes the admin's password hash
remediation: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements instead of string concatenation; apply strict input validation on authentication fields; avoid embedding sensitive fields like password hashes in JWT payloads; implement account lockout/anomaly detection on malformed login attempts

title: DOM-Based XSS via Search Query
impact: Allows execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser when a crafted search URL is visited; the Angular app rendered the query unsanitized into the DOM enabling session hijacking or phishing if a victim clicks a malicious link
remediation: Avoid Angular's bypassSecurityTrustHtml for user-controlled input; rely on Angular's built-in auto-sanitization; implement a strict Content-Security-Policy to block inline script/iframe execution

title: Stored XSS via Forged Product Review
payload_used: submitted via PUT request to the reviews API, impersonating another user (Forged Review)
impact: The reviews API accepts and stores HTML/JS payloads completely unsanitized; confirmed via direct API query showing the raw unescaped payload persisted in the database. This also allowed forging a review as another user without authorization, compounding the impact - the stored payload would execute for any user viewing the product's review section
remediation: Sanitize and HTML-encode all user-submitted review content on the server before storage and before rendering; enforce proper authorization checks so users can only submit/edit their own reviews; implement a Content-Security-Policy to mitigate any script execution that bypasses sanitization
